title: Cones, spheres, pyramids
examples: How do I find the surface area if the cone sits on a cylinder?
What is the formula for the total surface area of a pyramid?
Can you show me an example of a composite solid?

explain.say: Today we are looking at shapes like cones, spheres, and pyramids. We will learn about their surface areas. Remember that surface area is the total area covering the outside of a 3D shape.
Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: 3D shapes. Look at the cube, the cuboid and the cylinder. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.

Let us first look at the formula for a cone's total surface area. It is the area of the circular base plus the curved side. The formula is pi times radius times times radius, plus pi times radius times slant height.
For a composite solid, we must find the area of every exposed surface. Imagine a cone sitting on a cylinder. We only count the visible parts. We must subtract the area where the two shapes join.

draw.text: Composite Solid = Sum of exposed areas

explain.say: Consider a solid made of a cylinder and a hemisphere on top. The total surface area is the area of the cylinder's side, plus the cylinder's base, plus the curved surface of the hemisphere. We do not count the joining circle.

faq.q: Do I need to worry about the slant height for a cone?
faq.a: Yes, the slant height is important for the curved side area. You can find it using the Pythagorean theorem if you know the height and radius.
asks: How do I find the side length of a cone?

faq.q: When finding a composite solid's area, what do I always remove?
faq.a: You must always remove the area where the two shapes are stuck together. This is the overlapping circular area.
asks: Do I subtract the middle part?

faq.q: Is the sphere formula always used for the whole surface?
faq.a: Yes, the surface area of a full sphere is always four times pi times the radius squared. This covers the entire outer surface.
asks: How much area does a sphere have?
Is the sphere formula just 4pi r²?

faq.q: Do pyramids have a curved surface area?
faq.a: No, pyramids have flat triangular faces. You calculate the area of each triangle and add them all together for the total area.
asks: How do I find the area of a pyramid?

faq.q: If I find the total surface area, does that include the inside?
faq.a: No, total surface area only measures the outside surface. It does not measure any internal space or surfaces.
asks: Is volume different from surface area?

facts: The surface area of a sphere is given by the formula four times pi times radius squared.
The total surface area of a cone includes the area of the circular base.
When calculating composite solids, the joining area must be subtracted from the sum of individual surface areas.
A pyramid's surface area is the sum of the areas of all its triangular faces.

quiz.say: A cone has a radius of three units and a slant height of five units. What is its total surface area?
quiz.why: The total surface area is the base area plus the curved area, which is pi times three squared plus pi times three times five.

wrong.0: This only calculates the base area, forgetting the curved surface.
wrong.1: This incorrectly calculates the base area as pi times three.
wrong.2: This incorrectly adds the radius and slant height for the curved area.

quiz.say: A solid is formed by joining a hemisphere to a cube. If the hemisphere has a radius of two units, what is the exposed surface area?

options.show: Cube Area - Circle Area + Hemisphere Area
options.say: Cube Area - Circle Area + Hemisphere Area

quiz.why: You must find the cube's total area, subtract the circle area where the hemisphere joins, and then add the hemisphere's curved area.

wrong.0: This forgets to subtract the overlapping circular area.
wrong.1: This incorrectly subtracts the entire volume of the hemisphere.
wrong.2: This incorrectly adds the area twice instead of subtracting the overlap.

quiz.say: What is the total surface area of a square pyramid with a base side length of four units and triangular faces with a slant height of three units?
quiz.show: Pyramid TSA = Base Area + 4 Triangle Area
quiz.why: The area is the square base (four times four) plus the area of the four triangles (each being one half times four times three).

wrong.1: This is actually correct, but a common mistake is forgetting to divide by two for the triangle height.
wrong.2: This calculates only the area of the four triangles and forgets the square base.
wrong.3: This incorrectly calculates the triangle area by multiplying all three dimensions.
